_about: Player notes the data can't show, keyed by ESPN player id or full name: {"contract_year": true|false, "note": "short storyline"}. Kept up to date by the daily analyst task. contract_year feeds the measured 'Contract year' effect; notes are shown on player pages.

Tyler Herro.note: Leading Milwaukee after the Giannis trade; back from a knee bruise with 27 vs the Lakers; contract year.

Michael Porter Jr..note: On the trade block in a contract year; talks stalled over asking price.

Giannis Antetokounmpo.note: Called Doc Rivers' public criticism of his basketball IQ "insane"; playing through a sprained right wrist.

Jaylen Brown.note: Gave Tatum a frosty reception in his first game vs Boston; held to 13 points in a 22-point loss.

Kyle Kuzma.note: Called for more urgency as Milwaukee sit 1-10; faces his first NBA team, the Lakers.

Brandon Ingram.note: Close to his Clippers debut after heel surgery; practicing five-on-five.

Darryn Peterson.note: Four straight 20-point games for the 1-11 Jazz.

Ja Morant.note: Out with a hamstring strain he picked up against former team Memphis; coach says he may return sooner than four weeks.

Anthony Davis.note: Ripped Wizards' defense after a 44-point return; team reportedly wants 20-30 games before deciding on an extension.

Domantas Sabonis.note: Shrinking role next to rookie Darius Acuff Jr.; deadline-trade talk.

Darius Acuff Jr..note: Rookie scoring about 26 a game; openly frustrated at 1-10: "I'm not a loser, so it's not fun."

Noah Clowney.note: Frustration since losing his starting role; fouled out and shoved an opponent in Dallas.

Kevin Durant.note: Faces former team Golden State; within about 900 points of passing Kobe for 4th all-time; taking a career-low 12.3 shots a game.

Kristaps Porzingis.note: Stepped away for his health; Warriors withholding salary and trying to trade him.

Victor Wembanyama.note: 32 points as the Spurs won a 10th straight, rallying from 22 down in Chicago.

Trae Young.note: Faced former team Atlanta for the first time on Nov 6.

Paul George.note: Scored 36 against his former team, Philadelphia, in a 22-point win.

Karl-Anthony Towns.note: Extension talks stalled after he reportedly turned down about $200M; Knicks have reportedly raised a possible trade.

Kyrie Irving.note: At the centre of deadline trade talk; reportedly "not on the Mavericks' timeline".

Anthony Edwards.note: Out up to two months after knee surgery; the absence threatens the 65-game mark that matters for his supermax eligibility.

Jordan Poole.note: Says he hopes to return to Golden State when his contract runs out after this season.

Grayson Allen.note: Shooting about 47% from three for Charlotte; faces Phoenix for the first time since the June trade.

Royce O'Neale.note: Faces Phoenix for the first time since the June trade that sent Miles Bridges to the Suns.

Miles Bridges.note: Faces Charlotte, his longtime team, for the first time since the June trade.

Kawhi Leonard.note: Out at least another week with a knee issue; has played only two games since re-signing.

Stephen Curry.note: Left the Houston game with abdominal soreness; MRI pending, and Kerr says concern is high.

Marcus Smart.note: Ejected with a Flagrant 2 for punching Charles Bassey vs Golden State; possible discipline.

James Harden.note: Broke a scoring slump with a season-high 32 at the Knicks.

Franz Wagner.note: Three straight 30-point games with Banchero and Suggs out.

Ayo Dosunmu.note: Averaging 21.6 points while starting in place of the injured Anthony Edwards.

Cooper Flagg.note: Scored 43 against Indiana as Dallas won a third straight.

Caleb Wilson.note: No. 4 pick hurt his right hand vs San Antonio; no timetable.
